decisions.reason: The 15-day express delivery program is very close to the firm's existing manufacturing, planning, and service capabilities, so the firm can learn from early rollout and improve it at relatively low risk.

The 72-hour express delivery program stretches operations more than other launches, but it still builds on the firm's established door and logistics knowledge and supports its value proposition of fast response and low downtime.

The fire-resistant steel exterior door is a core-adjacent product with clear regulatory value and strong technical fit to the firm's R&D, engineering, and certification capabilities, making it highly improvable and commercially credible.

The express delivery program for doors and gates directly leverages the firm's existing product base, service network, and spare-parts logistics, so absorptive capacity for refining and scaling it is high.

The online ordering and digital services platform deepens the firm's established offer and service model, and a large integrated supplier can use customer and project knowledge to iteratively improve adoption and commercial use.

The fire and smoke protection door is closely related to the firm's established safety-compliance and technical door expertise, so existing knowledge and R&D should help it interpret demand and enhance the product.
